criterion.description: Minimum age: 20 Years
Maximum age: 80 Years
Individuals who have not been diagnosed with cancer during routine physical examinations and one-year follow-up.

Newly diagnosed cancer patients with a confirmed pathological diagnosis within 90 days before blood collection or within 30 days after blood collection, including lung cancer, esophageal cancer, breast cancer, stomach cancer, colorectal cancer, liver cancer, and pancreatic cancer.
